summary_1line: Sage Agastya marries princess Lopamudra, who later asks for proper royal comforts before conceiving, prompting him to seek wealth from several kings.

image_candidates.scene_text: Princess Lopamudra removes her jeweled robes and ornaments and dons bark garments beside the austere sage Agastya.
The king of Vidarbha swoons as the powerful sage Agastya requests his daughter’s hand in marriage.
Lopamudra, freshly bathed and radiant with ascetic splendor, respectfully asks Agastya to approach her adorned with garlands on a royal bed.
